kinds.description: A product or creative-work definition, separate from a particular physical copy or its availability.
An authored physical item's availability or condition, independent of the shop's record.
A fictional customer or financial account; distinct from the person, their cash and their reputation.
A contextual account condition, not a character judgment or a live financial fact.
A particular proposed or recorded exchange. Request, authorization, fulfillment and posting remain separate.
A stage of an exchange, including unresolved, pending and corrected outcomes.
A receipt, ledger entry or other account of an occurrence; may be incomplete, delayed or incorrect.
An explicit set of obligations and permissions among parties, scoped to objects and time.

relations.label: offers item
relations.description: Part of an advertised catalogue; not proof of an available copy.

relations.label: is a physical copy of
relations.description: Connects an actual item to its product or film definition; never transfers copy state to every item.

relations.label: is stocked at
relations.description: Supply location; stock, reservations and opening times remain separate.

relations.label: has inventory state
relations.description: An authored physical state at a stated time; not whatever a ledger happens to claim.

relations.label: has a reservation for
relations.description: A recorded claim to a future allocation; does not create stock or transfer ownership.

relations.label: has account holder
relations.description: Holding an account does not imply every relative has authority over it.

relations.label: is administered by
relations.description: Administrative responsibility separate from who benefits from the service.

relations.label: has account condition
relations.description: A fixture or proposed condition; no real balances, eligibility decisions or external finance access.

relations.label: has scoped authority on
relations.description: Authority must identify purpose and limits in qualifiers; acquaintance, kinship and card possession do not imply it.

relations.label: requests transaction
relations.description: A request is not an approved or completed transaction.

relations.label: concerns account
relations.description: The account implicated by an exchange; not a balance mutation.

relations.label: involves item or resource
relations.description: What is exchanged or disputed; ownership, custody and payment remain distinct.

relations.label: has transaction stage
relations.description: Requested, pending, completed and disputed are different authored states.

relations.label: is documented by
relations.description: A record can support or contradict an account of what happened; it is not infallible.

relations.label: purports to record
relations.description: Record content is an assertion about the target, not automatic world truth.

relations.label: conflicts with record
relations.description: Keep both accounts with provenance; a resolver must investigate rather than overwrite silently.

relations.label: is party to agreement
relations.description: An actual participant in this authored agreement, not everyone nearby.

relations.label: covers item or activity
relations.description: The particular scope of an agreement.

relations.label: requires fulfillment of
relations.description: An agreed duty; not every favor becomes a debt.

relations.label: is due during
relations.description: A named deadline window. No calendar arithmetic or late-fee execution is implied.

relations.label: is subject to account rule
relations.description: Fictional local policy; not a claim about current banking or consumer law.

relations.label: may substitute for
relations.description: A candidate alternative requiring consent, suitability and budget; never universal equivalence.

relations.label: can handle service situation
relations.description: Responsibility and opportunity, not omniscient knowledge or automatic resolution.

relations.label: has seen record
relations.description: Specific knowledge holder. Seeing a record does not prove that it is correct or that the holder accepts it.

relations.label: offers evidence for claim
relations.description: A piece of evidence, not an unconditional truth override.

relations.label: requests review of
relations.description: A review request can be accepted, postponed or refused within the scene's authored rules.

relations.label: was entered during
relations.description: Administrative entry time is separate from the underlying event's time.

relations.label: is entrusted with
relations.description: Custody and responsibility without necessarily having ownership or spending authority.

relations.label: is a customer of
relations.description: A service relationship, not personal closeness or a guaranteed transaction.

relations.label: may prompt stock response
relations.description: An opportunity to restock, inspect, wait or negotiate; not executable AI.

relations.label: may prompt service response
relations.description: Different people may respond differently to the same administrative state.

relations.label: can be a topic for
relations.description: A common interest, recommendation or disagreement without automatically revealing private taste.

relations.label: is handled at
relations.description: The service location; physical presence and private knowledge are still separate.

relations.label: includes errand or stop
relations.description: A proposed itinerary; actual arrival, queue length and deadlines are not simulated.

rows: Physically present; may still be reserved or unsuitable.
Reservation is not possession or purchase.
Custody has moved; ownership need not have changed.
The object is back even if a record still reports it missing.
Cause, timing and responsibility need evidence.
A shelf label or catalogue listing is not stock.
Temporarily unavailable without declaring anyone guilty.
An intention or application, not a completed exchange.
A delay is not proof of refusal or lack of means.
Only the stated exchange is complete; other obligations can remain.
Participants disagree about an exchange or its record.
Correction need not reach every witness.
A decision is separate from the person's worth or all future requests.
In good standing for this service
Institutional standing, not goodness as a person.
Authored fictional timing constraint; not a real bank's policy.
An administrative flag is not proof of misconduct.
A payment is recorded as due
The recorded claim can be disputed or corrected.
Waiting consumes time without implying compliance with every demand.
Dignity can be protected without disclosing a reason to bystanders.
Compare two accounts of an exchange
Keep original records and ask what each one actually establishes.
Selection depends on purpose, consent and practical constraints.
A valid choice with consequences elsewhere in the day.
The recipient can decline without being punished by the design.
An attempt to limit the audience, not guaranteed secrecy.
Explanation is separate from endorsing it or persuading the listener.
Can be reasonable, self-serving or both.
An exception can have costs for others and is not guaranteed.
A true explanation need not remove inconvenience or disappointment.
Maintains agency without a compulsory social penalty.
Priority can be negotiated for a reason; favoritism and access needs differ.
Public presence is not permission to disclose records.
A record is evidence, not an infallible verdict.
Permission has a purpose and limit
Recognition, kinship and custody do not create blanket authority.
Priority belongs to the person rather than a global completion score.
No obligation to tell the player everything.
Practical delays can have emotional significance.
Workers have lives after the counter closes.
Procedure, attention and compassion can conflict.
Fictional local closing time; not a current real-world schedule.
Shopping competes with staff closing duties.
Authored agreement window independent of processing time.
A household expectation, not a universal curfew.
Bank, groceries and a video return overlap without requiring a crisis at every stop.
A queue or missing document changes opportunities elsewhere; no scripted catastrophe is required.
A reason exists but is not public
Knowing why someone is delayed does not oblige them to tell every witness.
The day can end with groceries bought, records settled and a film returned, with no quest reward.
